# bullwhip

> Nightly batch data-pipeline framework: cron + GNU Make + dlt-ops + SQLMesh.
> Modernized from the 2013 Wunderlist data pipeline. Three ledgers, three
> read-only projections, one cron line.

## What it is

bullwhip is a skeleton for nightly batch data pipelines. It uses cron for
scheduling, GNU Make for the cross-system DAG, dlt-ops for EL with data quality
gates, and SQLMesh for in-warehouse transforms. No scheduler daemon, no
workers, no web server — just a makefile and a cron line.

## Architecture

```
cron (every 30 min, 00:00–06:00)
  └─ run_workflow.sh          single-flight, bounded attempts, attempt logs
       └─ make -k -j N        the ONLY place cross-system edges exist
            ├─ dlt-ops pipeline run     (ingest + assertions + ledger)
            ├─ dlt-ops pipeline reconcile (schema-drift detection)
            ├─ sqlmesh run               (transforms)
            ├─ exports / backups         (fingerprint-gated markers)
            └─ notifications
```

## Key files

- `lib/run_workflow.sh` — cron entry point, retry loop, status.json heartbeat, logs/index.json night index
- `.github/workflows/nightly.yml` — GitHub Actions as the cron: daily 03:00 UTC, state in actions/cache, secrets via env, dashboards to GitHub Pages
- `scripts/build_site.sh` — assembles web/ + a project's logs/ into a static site (what the Action publishes)
- `lib/boilerplate.mk` — make boilerplate, dated targets, tracking shell
- `lib/tracking_shell.py` — vendored, self-contained, writes timing_env.log
- `lib/connections.py` — connector registry (DuckDB, MotherDuck, BigQuery, ClickHouse)
- `lib/run_pipeline.py` — thin dlt wrapper (fallback for simple cases)
- `lib/dlt_ops_fallback.py` — escape hatch if dlt-ops breaks
- `lib/critical_path.py` — Mara organ 1: critical-path priority, .WAIT waves, dag.json
- `lib/fingerprint.py` — Mara organ 2: content-hash cache keys
- `lib/run_ledger.py` — outcome record: dlt-ops runs + DuckDB row counts → logs/<date>/ledger.json
- `lib/warehouse_parquet.py` — parquet export/restore: data/*.parquet is the durable copy, warehouse.duckdb is ephemeral and rebuilt from it
- `lib/notify_slack.py` — Slack failure ping + morning digest
- `.dlt/config.toml` — dlt-ops project config
- `sqlmesh/config.yaml` — SQLMesh gateway config
- `sqlmesh/models/` — SQL models with audits
- `sqlmesh/macros/` — Python macros
- `web/` — static dashboards (plain HTML + vanilla JS, no build step, relative paths so they work from any static host; six views over one night's artifacts)
- `mcp/` — TypeScript MCP server (6 read-only tools, stdio transport)
- `examples/github-health/` — primary example: GitHub trending-repo health tracker
- `examples/incremental_load/` — minimal example: people table ingest + transform

## Division of labor

| Concern | Owner |
|---|---|
| Cadence, retries, locking, attempt logs | cron (or GitHub Actions) + run_workflow.sh |
| DAG across heterogeneous steps | make |
| Dependency graph inside the warehouse | SQLMesh |
| Incremental state, backfills, restatements | dlt-ops (ingest) / SQLMesh (transform) |
| Data quality | dlt-ops assertions + SQLMesh audits |
| EL ops (validate, gates, ledger, checkpoints, drift) | dlt-ops |
| Metaprogramming | SQLMesh macros + Python models |
| Priority + content sensitivity at the make layer | critical_path.py + fingerprint.py |
| Observability / notification / agent access | UI, Slack, MCP (read-only projections) |

## The three ledgers

| Ledger | What it answers | Where |
|---|---|---|
| timing_env.log | What ran at 3am and how long | logs/<date>/timing_env.log |
| dlt-ops state | Which source window is loaded + run outcomes | warehouse.duckdb _dlt_ops_runs |
| SQLMesh state | Which transform intervals are complete | warehouse.duckdb .sqlmesh/ |

## The three projections (read-only, no new state)

- HTML (live + archive): six dashboards (Flask-port Gantt, Plot+ELK DAG, outcome ledger, monochrome vitals, plus two monochrome reductions) served from web/
- Slack: failure ping (v0) + morning digest (v1)
- MCP (stdio): night_status, night_stats, list_targets, night_summary, get_target_log, explain_critical_path

## Quick start

```bash
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cd examples/github-health
GITHUB_HEALTH_FIXTURE=1 make imports
make query
```

See docs/tutorial.md for the full walkthrough.

## Lineage

- night-shift (soobrosa, 2013) — the whole shape: cron + make, run_workflow.sh, boilerplate.mk, dated markers, timing_env.log, attempt logs (https://github.com/soobrosa/night-shift)
- trackingshell (Wunderlist) — lib/tracking_shell.py is a self-contained rewrite of its make-shell idea (https://github.com/wunderlist/trackingshell)
- Mara (mara-pipelines) — the three organs: critical-path priority, content-hash cache keys, and the outcome record (https://github.com/mara/mara-pipelines)
- dataroom (soobrosa) — the monochrome dashboard language of D, E and F (https://github.com/soobrosa/dataroom)

## Dependencies

Runtime, Python (pyproject.toml):
- dlt (dlt[duckdb]) by dltHub — extract + load; the github_health source, schema inference, merge loads
- dlt-ops — project validation, pipeline run, runs ledger _dlt_ops_runs, schema-drift reconcile, backfill
- SQLMesh (sqlmesh[duckdb]) by Tobiko Data — transform models, intervals, audits, plan/run
- DuckDB by DuckDB Foundation / DuckDB Labs — the single warehouse file both tools share
- Optional extras: dlt[postgres], dlt[bigquery] + google-cloud-bigquery, dlt[clickhouse] + clickhouse-connect

Runtime, non-Python:
- GNU Make — the DAG; 3.81 (macOS) works, 4.4+ for .WAIT waves
- bash + cron, or GitHub Actions — cadence
- uv (Astral) — dependency install in the Action
- GitHub REST API — the example's data source (GITHUB_TOKEN, PAT, or GITHUB_HEALTH_FIXTURE=1 for none)
- Slack incoming webhooks — optional failure ping / morning digest
- Python 3.11+

Dashboards and agent access:
- Observable Plot (@observablehq/plot@0.4, jsDelivr) — dashboard B's Gantt
- elkjs (elkjs@0.8.2, jsDelivr) — dashboard B's DAG layout
- @modelcontextprotocol/sdk — mcp/ server (TypeScript)
- Any static file server / GitHub Pages — the dashboards are plain HTML + vanilla JS

Dev only: pytest, pytest-cov, TypeScript + @types/node (mcp), Homebrew make, headless Chrome (docs/visuals/ screenshots)

## Failure semantics

- Every worker is a subprocess with exit codes; make composes them
- dlt-ops commits atomically per load before its marker lands
- Single-flight (ps check) prevents overlapping sqlmesh run at cron frequency
- Green-marker ≠ green-data: dlt-ops gates judge data before it loads; SQLMesh audits judge after
- data/*.parquet is the source of truth; warehouse.duckdb is rebuilt from it whenever missing (re-ingest is idempotent, models re-materialise)
